# Mossland Verified Links

> Mossland Verified Links — the official directory of verified Mossland domains, ecosystem apps, labs, official channels, and third-party market references. Anything not listed here should be treated as unofficial.

Mossland is infrastructure for the AI civilization. This file lists the verified official Mossland domains, plus the official channels and accounts Mossland operates on third-party platforms, so search engines and AI agents can resolve real Mossland services and avoid impersonators. The machine-readable source of truth is the JSON registry below.

## Official
- [Mossland](https://www.moss.land/): Official
- [Disclosure](https://disclosure.moss.land/): Official Records
- [Medium](https://medium.com/mossland-blog): Blog
- [X](https://x.com/TheMossland): Social

## Participation
- [Passport](https://passport.moss.land/): Wallet verification · participation record
- [Agora](https://agora.moss.land/): Public Decision Layer
- [Mossverse](https://wa.moss.land/): Web3 virtual world where your wallet is your identity

## Ecosystem
> Mossland's ecosystem services. Anything marked 실험 (Experimental) is not yet a finished official product or governance.
- [Alpha](https://alpha.moss.land/): Crypto, macro & geopolitics media curation
- [Signal Map](https://signalmap.moss.land/): YouTuber opinion & issue map
- [Media](https://media.moss.land/): Media stance map (by issue)
- [City](https://city.moss.land/): Self-running AI city
- [NPC](https://npc.moss.land/): Chat with AI residents
- [Recipe](https://recipe.moss.land/): Recreate trending AI outputs (prompt gallery)
- [MOSS.AO](https://ao.moss.land/): AI agent orchestration engine
- [Algora](https://algora.moss.land/en): Multi-agent governance deliberation (lab)
- [BRIDGE](https://bridge.moss.land/): Physical AI governance research
- [Governance Monitor](https://monitor.moss.land/): Live dashboard for the AO·Algora·BRIDGE governance stack

## Source of truth
- [Ecosystem Registry (JSON)](https://links.moss.land/ecosystem-registry.json): structured, machine-readable registry of every Mossland service with tier, status, and Passport eligibility.
- [Registry JSON Schema](https://links.moss.land/ecosystem-registry.schema.json): the contract for the registry.

## Notes
- Agora is Mossland's public decision layer: proposals and voting use gasless EIP-712 wallet signatures (no on-chain transaction), weighted by each voter's delegated MOC voting power at a fixed snapshot block (ERC20Votes getPastVotes, with a balanceOf fallback for holders who have never delegated). Unless a proposal explicitly says otherwise, Mossland DAO treats an Agora result as its binding decision of record.
- Labs (AO, Algora, BRIDGE) are experimental; not official products or governance.
- Markets / third-party links are reference only and are not trading recommendations.
